name: MixMod dynamic-mask alternative (magnitude threshold; probably fails as written)
plain: Meant to give the first model the 'foreground' and the second the rest, using a threshold on the first model's normalized |c| magnitude, then a masked blend of each model's own CFG output. As read, the guider sets self.depth_model only in foreground_background mode, so this mode looks like it would raise AttributeError on its first step (inference from reading, not run). If a depth model were present the code would use a flat 0.5 mask, since the magnitude heuristic runs only when depth_model is None.
math:
Heuristic (depth_model None): g = mean_ch|c₁|; ĝ = (g − min g)/(max g − min g); M = [ĝ > τ], M ← 1 − M if invert; M ← avgpool_k(M), k = max(3, 2⌊4σ+0.5⌋+1).
Depth-model branch: M = 0.5 everywhere.
Masks [M, 1 − M, 0, …] normalized, then x̂ = Σᵢ m̂ᵢ·(uᵢ + sᵢ(cᵢ − uᵢ)).
